title: secondary
intro:
Specify secondary domain.
    The secondary domain consist typically of soil fractures or other inter-aggregate
pores small enough to be dominated by capillarity, yet so large that water moves
fast enough that the solute equilibrium with the primary domain (typically intra-
aggregate pores) can not be maintained.
    This allows a pulse of water to be move through saturated or near saturated
soil without solutes in the new water being mixed with solutes in the old water.
The effects are twofold: It allows solutes applied to the surface to reach deeper soil
layers much faster than it would otherwise, and it protects solutes in the soil matrix
from being washed out with fast moving new water.
    Used by horizon component secondary domain (see 47, page 231) .

sections.desc: Shared base class for non-empty secondary domains.

attrs.name: alpha
attrs.doc: Exchange rate between primary and secondary water.

sections.name: cracks
sections.desc:
A ‘alpha’ model (see 78.1, page 423) build into Daisy.
   Secondary domain specified by aperture and density of soil cracks.
sections.sig:
< cracks (density density )
              (use secondary true)
              (aperture aperture )
              ;; Shared parameters are described in section 78.1.
              (alpha alpha ) >

attrs.name: use secondary
attrs.doc:
Divide soil matrix into two domains for solute transport. Set this to false to
     make cracks affect only the conductivity curve.

attrs.name: aperture
attrs.doc: Average distance between walls in cracks.

sections.text:
A ‘alpha’ model (see 78.1, page 423) build into Daisy.
   Secondary domain specified by aperture and density of soil cracks.
  < cracks (density density )
              (use secondary true)
              (aperture aperture )

    density: number [m−1 ]
     Parameter
     Density of cracks.

    use secondary: boolean (see section 4.1.2)

       aperture: number [m]

sections.name: pressure
sections.desc:
A ‘alpha’ model (see 78.1, page 423) build into Daisy.
   Horizon has secondary domain specifyed by pressure thresshold.
   The secondary domain consist of water in matrix pores larger than what corre-
sponds to the specified pressure.
sections.sig:
< pressure (K 0 [cm/h])
                 (h lim h lim )
                 (use secondary true)
                 ;; Shared parameters are described in section 78.1.
                 (alpha alpha ) >

attrs.name: K
attrs.doc:
Water conductivity when secondary domain is active. If the secondary domain
        is already included in the normal conductivity curve, specify 0.0 to use that
        value instead.

attrs.name: h lim
attrs.doc: Minimal pressure needed for activating secondary domain.

attrs.name: use secondary
attrs.doc:
Divide soil matrix into two domains for solute transport. Set this to false to
        make h lim affect only the conductivity curve.

sections.name: none
sections.desc:
No secondary domain.
   There is always full equilibrium between solute in different size matrix pores.
